name: Plant & process engineering
summary: Find the real constraint and fix it without a capital project.
description: We map material and information flow, measure where the line actually loses time, and design the smallest change that recovers capacity. The work stays grounded in the equipment you already run.
outcomes: Capacity and debottlenecking studies with a ranked action list
Process documentation your operators will actually use

name: Maintenance & reliability
summary: Move from reactive repairs to a maintenance plan you can defend.
description: We review asset criticality, failure history, and spare-parts reality, then build a preventive plan that fits the crew you have. The goal is fewer surprises, not a binder that never leaves the office.

name: Energy & emissions programs
summary: Cut energy intensity with projects that survive the payback test.
description: We baseline energy use by line and shift, find recoverable heat and idle load, and sequence projects by payback and operational risk. Every recommendation includes a measurement plan.
outcomes: Energy and emissions baseline by process area
Measurement and verification plan for each project
